The only 2024-onwards scientific deliverable explicitly attributed to him on his LPP page is the **MAKOS Heliophysics mission concept study** (Decadal Survey 2024-2033 Whitepaper #135) - a research deliverable and a community-input artifact, neither of which is a personal grant allocation and neither of which promises doctoral or postdoc funding to him.

On hiring, the **presence list** on the Equipe Plasmas Spatiaux page (11 doctoral students and 10 post-docs in 2026) is dense and signals that the team is actively staffed-supervising, but the page does not name supervisors, so it cannot, on its own, be read as "Retinò is hiring". No external posting - LPP `/offres`, IP-Paris career portal, EURAXESS, LinkedIn, X - currently advertises an open PhD, postdoc, research engineer, or staff role under his supervision with a 2026 publication date.

The **recommended next-step** for a deeper audit is: (i) browse the LPP personal page in a JS-enabled client to capture the populated `Activités et responsabilités scientifiques` block; (ii) query the ANR project search engine with the institutional address string rather than bare name; (iii) check CORDIS by author/participant ("Alessandro Retino" or "Retinò", organisation CNRS, programme HORIZON); (iv) inspect EURAXESS using keyword `Magnetic reconnection` over the past 90 days; (v) check Ecole Doctorale ED 564 (Physique en Ile-de-France) for LPP-hosted PhD subjects and supervisor names.
